_note: Lanternvale content items: consumables (with hidden use_* abilities and cn_* auras), quest items, junk, reagents, vendor commons, named greens/blues, the Warden's epic, companion starting gear and random-green suffixes. Prices are buy prices in copper (items sell for 1/4).

items.name: Minor Healing Potion
items.description: Tastes faintly of peppermint and pennies.

items.name: Lesser Healing Potion
items.description: A ruby-red draught brewed with camphor leaf.

items.name: Healing Potion
items.description: Warm as a hearth. The cork glows faintly.

items.name: Minor Mana Potion
items.description: Fizzy, blue, and tastes like a thunderstorm smells.

items.name: Lesser Mana Potion
items.description: Swirls on its own when nobody is looking.

items.name: Minor Rejuvenation Potion
items.description: Half red, half blue, and stubbornly refuses to mix.

items.name: Rage Potion
items.description: Brewed from boar's blood and bad tempers.

items.name: Honeyed Rice Ball
items.description: Wrapped in a camphor leaf by someone who cared.

items.name: Honey Cake
items.description: Small spirits are said to find these irresistible. So are large adventurers.

items.name: Glowcap Skewer
items.description: Grilled forest mushrooms. They stop glowing after the second bite, mostly.

items.name: Sleepy Lantern Stew
items.description: Dorrit's own recipe. Nobody has ever finished a bowl and then wanted to fight anything.

items.name: Lanternvale Spring Water
items.description: Cold enough to make your teeth sing.

items.name: Roasted Barley Tea
items.description: Nutty, warm and served in a chipped cup.

items.name: Cold Melon Juice
items.description: Pressed from Bram's prize melons. He will mention this.

items.name: Linen Bandage
items.description: Clean, if not exactly new.

items.name: Wool Bandage
items.description: Thick and itchy, but it holds.

items.name: Elixir of Lion's Strength
items.description: Smells like wet fur and courage.

items.name: Elixir of Minor Agility
items.description: Your fingers tingle before you've even uncorked it.

items.name: Elixir of Minor Fortitude
items.description: Thick, earthy and good for you, as all terrible things are.

items.name: Elixir of Minor Defense
items.description: Leaves a faint stony aftertaste.

items.name: Elixir of Wisdom
items.description: Brewed under a full moon by someone who insisted that mattered.

items.name: Lantern-Oil Tonic
items.description: Tilly swears by it against 'the grey'. It is mostly lamp oil, honey and hope.

items.name: Garrow's Whetstone
items.description: A palm-worn stone. Garrow insists it 'knows what it's doing'.

items.name: Scroll of Stamina
items.description: The ink shifts when you read it aloud.

items.name: Scroll of Strength
items.description: The ink shifts when you read it aloud.

items.name: Scroll of Agility
items.description: The ink shifts when you read it aloud.

items.name: Scroll of Intellect
items.description: The ink shifts when you read it aloud.

items.name: Scroll of Spirit
items.description: The ink shifts when you read it aloud.

items.name: Scroll of Protection
items.description: The ink shifts when you read it aloud.

items.name: Kindling Taper
items.description: A long beeswax taper lit from every hearth in Lanternvale. Its small flame never quite goes out, though it never quite grows either.

items.name: Spirit Ember
items.description: A warm mote of light rescued from a Hollow wisp. It hums, very faintly, like a cat that is trying not to.

items.name: Lantern Wick
items.description: A braided spirit-wick, slightly nibbled. Mossling teeth marks, by the look of it.

items.name: Fennick's Satchel
items.description: A battered leather mail satchel, sticky with spider silk. The letters inside are mostly dry.

items.name: Keeper Ishiro's Letter
items.description: Sealed with grey wax and addressed to Elder Maru in a careful, shaking hand. It is three weeks late.

items.name: Nell's Spirit Bell
items.description: A tiny brass bell on a red string. Nell says Moppet always comes when it rings. Almost always.

items.name: Sticky Web Strand
items.description: It is still trying to stick to something.

items.name: Ruffled Owl Feather
items.description: Soft as a whisper and twice as quiet.

items.name: Tiny Leaf Hat
items.description: Far too small for you. You try it on anyway.

items.name: Collection of Damp Pebbles
items.description: Lovingly sorted by size and shininess.

items.name: Chipped Dice
items.description: Both of them land on six. Suspicious.

items.name: Bandit's Bad Poetry
items.description: 'O toll, O toll, thou pays't thy toll / or else we taketh thy... goll.' It goes on like this.

items.name: Pinch of Grey Ash
items.description: It leaves no smudge on your fingers. That's worse, somehow.

items.name: Faded Prayer Strip
items.description: Whatever was written here has been emptied out.

items.name: Shiny Button
items.description: Pip would like this.

items.name: Lanternguard Breastplate
items.description: Heavy ceremonial plate from the old Lantern Guard. Only seasoned knights have the training to wear it.

items.name: Willow Wand
items.description: Snapped from the old willow by the well. It didn't mind.

items.name: Ember Twig Wand
items.description: Smells of bonfire night.

items.name: Frost-Etched Wand
items.description: Always cold, even in a pocket.

items.name: Gloom Wand
items.description: Tilly keeps it at the back of the stall, wrapped in a tea towel.

items.name: Pilgrim's Cowl
items.description: Stitched with the names of shrines, each one crossed out with a little lantern.

items.name: Lamplighter's Gloves
items.description: Singed at every fingertip. Tobben says that's how you know they work.

items.name: Mossweave Sandals
items.description: Woven by Mosslings, who were very proud and only slightly confused about feet.

items.name: Robe of the Ember Wick
items.description: The hem smoulders politely and never catches.

items.name: Hexer's Charm-Hung Robe
items.description: Every little charm jingles a different curse.

items.name: Bindings of Quiet Dusk
items.description: They make the moment after sunset last a little longer.

items.name: Starlit Trousers
items.description: Embroidered with constellations nobody in the valley has a name for.

items.name: Bristleback Jerkin
items.description: Still bristly. Wear a shirt underneath.

items.name: Wolfrunner Boots
items.description: Soft-soled and silent. The sheep never heard them coming either.

items.name: Cutthroat's Hood
items.description: Comes with a matching scowl, sold separately.

items.name: Spiderhide Bracers
items.description: Faintly tacky. Excellent for catching thrown things.

items.name: Shepherd's Fleece Vest
items.description: Bram's spare. It smells of hay, rain and a very loyal dog.

items.name: Whisperwood Stalker Leggings
items.description: Patched with moss in all the places that matter.

items.name: Puddlecap's Mushroom Hat
items.description: A gift of Mossling friendship, enlarged with great ceremony and a lot of string.

items.name: Cogwright Goggles
items.description: Three lenses, two straps, one very important sticker.

items.name: Bridgewarden's Hauberk
items.description: Issued to the Old Bridge's last proper warden, who retired to keep bees.

items.name: Guardsman's Coif
items.description: Sergeant Holt's spare. He says it's lucky; it has a dent shaped like a goose.

items.name: Hornkin-Riveted Gauntlets
items.description: Hammered on a mountain anvil and riveted with horn.

items.name: Stoneford Greaves
items.description: Built for wading cold rivers and standing your ground in them.

items.name: Wayfarer's Chain Boots
items.description: They have walked the pilgrim road more times than you have.

items.name: Vanguard Breastplate of the Lantern
items.description: A lantern is etched over the heart, worn smooth by a hundred gauntleted salutes.

items.name: Lantern-Knight Gauntlets
items.description: Built to hold a lantern steady in a gale. Or a sword.

items.name: Thornwood Staff
items.description: Grown, not carved. A thorn still sprouts at the top every spring.

items.name: Shepherd's Crook
items.description: Excellent for retrieving lambs, villains and dropped sandwiches.

items.name: Bandit's Gutting Knife
items.description: The handle is carved with tally marks. You decide not to count them.

items.name: Tidecaller Knuckles
items.description: Inlaid with island shell. They sound like the sea when you punch things.

items.name: Woodsplitter
items.description: It has split a great deal of wood and is ready to branch out.

items.name: Lamp-Iron Mace
items.description: Forged from melted-down lamp brackets. It glows a little when swung in the dark.

items.name: Brightsteel Shortsword
items.description: Garrow's finest work. He'll tell you so, too.

items.name: Mosswood Longbow
items.description: The string is spider silk. The spider was not consulted.

items.name: Tinker's Hand-Cannon
items.description: Goes off roughly when you want it to, which is better than most.

items.name: Rattling Crossbow
items.description: Something inside it rattles. It has always rattled. Do not fix the rattle.

items.name: Bridgekeeper's Glaive
items.description: Long enough to keep a bandit at arm's length. Several arms, in fact.

items.name: Lantern-Glass Wand
items.description: A sliver of spirit-lantern glass on a rowan rod. It remembers being bright.

items.name: Hexer's Fetish Wand
items.description: Bundled bones, twine and one very sarcastic bead.

items.name: Sprocket Dagger
items.description: A blade bolted to a cog. Pip insists the cog is load-bearing.

items.name: Pip's Throwing Sprockets
items.description: Pip will want these back. Pip will not get these back.

items.name: Oaken Heater Shield
items.description: Painted with a lantern. The paint is newer than the dents.

items.name: Wayside Paper Lantern
items.description: A paper lantern from the Wayside Shrine. It glows whenever someone nearby is being kind.

items.name: Nell's Lucky Acorn
items.description: Nell drew a face on it. It is, she insists, a very lucky face.

items.name: Moppet's Moss Charm
items.description: A tuft of living moss on a string. It hums when spirits are near.

items.name: Valley Brass Band
items.description: Every Lanternvale child is given one at their naming. This one was never claimed.

items.name: Willow Ring
items.description: A loop of living willow, still in leaf.

items.name: Cutpurse's Signet
items.description: The crest is filed off. The crest was probably stolen too.

items.name: Wolf-Tooth Necklace
items.description: Bram made it from teeth he found in the pasture. He says the wolves won't miss them.

items.name: Mossy Cloak
items.description: It is not so much a cloak as a very committed patch of moss.

items.name: Courier's Swift Cloak
items.description: Fennick's old cloak, patched with stamps. Letters never arrive late in it.

items.name: Braided Horn-Charm
items.description: Hornkin braid one cord for every vow they keep.

items.name: Kael's Notched Greatsword
items.description: Every notch is a story. Kael tells none of them.

items.name: Red Wanderer's Greatcoat
items.description: Faded from crimson to the colour of old embers. Chainmail hides in the lining.

items.name: Obsidian Orb Staff
items.description: The orb holds a single, very patient storm.

items.name: Gown of Many Belts
items.description: Fourteen belts. Each has a purpose. Lys will not tell you what they are.

items.name: Pilgrim's Ringed Staff
items.description: Its rings chime softly with every step of a pilgrimage.

items.name: Summoner's Hakama Robe
items.description: Pale blue, tied with a sash her mother wore.

items.name: Saltreach Recurve
items.description: Made from driftwood and stubbornness on the Saltreach Isles.

items.name: Islander's Hand-Axe
items.description: Good for coconuts, kindling and arguments.

items.name: Ringball Captain's Vest
items.description: Number seven. Rook says it's lucky. Rook says most things are lucky.

items.name: Hornkin Spear-Staff
items.description: A ceremonial staff tipped with a leaf-shaped blade, more vow than weapon.

items.name: Hornkin Fur Wrap
items.description: Mountain wool and stitched hide, warm enough for snowfields.

items.name: Sunmere Hammer
items.description: Polished daily. Mostly so Aldric can see himself in it.

items.name: Sun-Painted Kite Shield
items.description: The sun was painted by Aldric himself. It has a face. It is winking.

items.name: Sunmere Tabard Hauberk
items.description: Bright gold over bright mail. Subtlety is for other knights.

items.name: Morwen's Letter-Opener
items.description: Silver, slender, and used exclusively for letters. Allegedly.

items.name: Grimoire of Polite Introductions
items.description: Chapter one: how to address a demon at dinner.

items.name: Ashcombe Ravenweave Coat
items.description: High-collared, violet-lined and impossibly clean.

items.name: Greymane's Mantle
items.description: The old alpha's silver ruff. The grey has washed out of it now; it is only silver.

items.name: Rusk's Toll-Taker
items.description: Its edge is notched with every 'toll' Rusk ever collected. There are fewer notches than he claimed.

items.name: Heartwood Bulwark
items.description: Cut from Rotheart's core, where the blight never reached. The rings still grow, very slowly.

items.name: Keeper Ishiro's Prayer Beads
items.description: One bead for every lantern on the pilgrim road. Ishiro counted them every night for forty years.

items.name: Komorebi's Hanging Lantern
items.description: Dappled light spills from it the way sun falls through leaves.

items.name: Farmer's Lucky Coin
items.description: Rusk's last coin, which he refused to spend on anything but seed. Now it's yours. Plant something.

items.name: Pilgrim-Guardian's Blade
items.description: Carried up the mountain beside every pilgrim for a hundred years. It came back every time.

items.name: Staff of the Kindled Hearth
items.description: A sliver of every hearth in Lanternvale burns in its crown.

items.name: Ember-Stitched Jerkin
items.description: The stitches glow faintly when you hold your breath.

items.name: Hauberk of the Long Night
items.description: Forged for those who stand watch until the lanterns come back.

items.name: Kindlewarm Robe
items.description: Warm as a cat on a windowsill, in every weather.

items.name: Bow of the Lantern Road
items.description: Strung beneath Old Kusu. Its arrows always find their way home.

items.name: Antler-Lantern Charm
items.description: A fragment of the Warden's antler with a tiny flame curled inside it, asleep.

items.name: Lanternbough
items.description: Carved from an antler the Warden shed in a gentler year. A small lantern swings from the crook, and wherever it goes, it is never quite dark.

items.name: Second-Best Paring Knife
items.description: Garrow keeps a bucket of these by the door. "For the other hand," he says, as though that explains everything.

items.name: Lefty's Shortsword
items.description: Garrow swears he forged it backwards, so it only fits a left hand. It fits a right hand perfectly well. Nobody has the heart to tell him.

items.name: Cocooned Knuckle-Claw
items.description: Found wrapped in silk in the spider hollow. Whoever wore it last left in a hurry, and without it.

items.name: Cutpurse's Second Opinion
items.description: For when the first knife's argument was not quite persuasive enough.

items.name: Rusk's Small Change
items.description: Rusk kept a second blade for the small tolls. There were, he admits, a great many small tolls.
